spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od4m4p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Cars, Caps, MaxEpoch
ASSUME Caps \subseteq (Nat \ {0})
VARIABLES status, tepoch, epoch, cap

Queued == "queued"
Washing == "washing"
Done == "done"
Gone == "gone"
States == {Queued, Washing, Done, Gone}

TypeOK ==
    /\ status \in [Cars -> States]
    /\ tepoch \in [Cars -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ cap \in Caps

WashingCars == {c \in Cars : status[c] = Washing}
OnLine == Cardinality(WashingCars)

Init ==
    /\ status = [c \in Cars |-> Queued]
    /\ tepoch = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ cap = CHOOSE k \in Caps : \A j \in Caps : k <= j

Admit(c) ==
    /\ status[c] = Queued
    /\ OnLine < cap
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![c] = Washing]
    /\ tepoch' = [tepoch EXCEPT ![c] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, cap>>

Finish(c) ==
    /\ status[c] = Washing
    /\ tepoch[c] = epoch
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![c] = Done]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tepoch, epoch, cap>>

Depart(c) ==
    /\ status[c] = Done
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![c] = Gone]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tepoch, epoch, cap>>

Rejoin(c) ==
    /\ status[c] = Gone
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![c] = Queued]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tepoch, epoch, cap>>

Reconfigure(k) ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ k \in Caps
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ cap' = k
    /\ status' = [c \in Cars |-> IF status[c] = Washing THEN Queued ELSE status[c]]
    /\ UNCHANGED tepoch

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Admit(c) \/ Finish(c) \/ Depart(c) \/ Rejoin(c)
    \/ \E k \in Caps : Reconfigure(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<status, tepoch, epoch, cap>>

AuthorizedLine == \A c \in Cars : status[c] = Washing => tepoch[c] = epoch
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cars = {c1, c2, c3}
    Caps = {1, 2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TypeOK
INVARIANT AuthorizedLine
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line processes cars from a fixed pool. Each car is either queued outside, currently on the wash line, finished, or has driven away. The line has a live capacity limit that an operator can change at runtime, and admission uses backpressure: a queued car is only pulled onto the line while the number of cars already washing is below the current capacity. Every configuration change stamps a new epoch onto the system and immediately evicts all cars presently on the line back to the queue, because their admission was authorized under the old configuration. A car may only complete its wash if the epoch it was admitted under still equals the current epoch, so a stale car whose authorization predates a reconfiguration can never finish. Finished cars drive away and may later rejoin the queue.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every car currently on the wash line was admitted under the configuration epoch that is still in force, so no stale or de-authorized car ever occupies the line.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od0m6p2t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Kits, Surgeries, Free, MaxClock, Lease
ASSUME Lease \in Nat /\ Free \notin Surgeries
VARIABLES owner, storeSet, deadline, clock

TypeOK ==
    /\ storeSet \in SUBSET Kits
    /\ deadline \in [Kits -> 0..MaxClock]
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
    /\ \A k \in Kits : owner[k] = Free \/ owner[k] \in Surgeries

Init ==
    /\ owner = [k \in Kits |-> Free]
    /\ storeSet = Kits
    /\ deadline = [k \in Kits |-> 0]
    /\ clock = 0

Acquire(s, k) ==
    /\ owner[k] = Free
    /\ k \in storeSet
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![k] = s]
    /\ storeSet' = storeSet \ {k}
    /\ deadline' = [deadline EXCEPT ![k] = IF clock + Lease <= MaxClock THEN clock + Lease ELSE MaxClock]
    /\ UNCHANGED clock

Return(s, k) ==
    /\ owner[k] = s
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![k] = Free]
    /\ storeSet' = storeSet \cup {k}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<deadline, clock>>

Expire(k) ==
    /\ owner[k] # Free
    /\ clock >= deadline[k]
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![k] = Free]
    /\ storeSet' = storeSet \cup {k}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<deadline, clock>>

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxClock
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, storeSet, deadline>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Surgeries, k \in Kits : Acquire(s, k) \/ Return(s, k)
    \/ \E k \in Kits : Expire(k)
    \/ Tick

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<owner, storeSet, deadline, clock>>

Conserved == storeSet = {k \in Kits : owner[k] = Free}
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Kits = {k1, k2}
    Surgeries = {s1, s2}
    Free = free
    MaxClock = 3
    Lease = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TypeOK
INVARIANT Conserved
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler manages a fixed pool of shared anesthesia kits. Each kit is either sitting in the central store or leased to exactly one surgery. A surgery acquires a kit only when that kit is currently in the store, and the lease is stamped with an expiry deadline measured against a shared clock. A surgery may be slow: it need not return its kit promptly, but it has not failed and will eventually act. If a lease's deadline passes, the scheduler reclaims the kit into the store even without the surgery's cooperation. The recorded store set and the per-kit owner assignment are two views of the same physical reality and must always agree, so that no kit is ever duplicated across two surgeries or lost between the store and a lease.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the set of kits recorded as being in the store is exactly the set of kits owned by no surgery, so every kit is accounted for in exactly one place and none is created or destroyed.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od18m4p2t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS NCmds, NLocks, QCap
ASSUME NCmds \in Nat /\ NLocks \in (Nat \ {0})
VARIABLES cstate, queue, crashed, doorLocked

Cmds == 1..NCmds
Locks == 1..NLocks
Target(c) == ((c - 1) % NLocks) + 1

New == "new"
Queued == "queued"
Delivered == "delivered"
Dropped == "dropped"

Range(q) == {q[i] : i \in 1..Len(q)}

TypeOK ==
    /\ cstate \in [Cmds -> {New, Queued, Delivered, Dropped}]
    /\ queue \in Seq(Cmds)
    /\ crashed \in [Locks -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ doorLocked \in [Locks -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ Len(queue) <= QCap

Init ==
    /\ cstate = [c \in Cmds |-> New]
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ crashed = [l \in Locks |-> FALSE]
    /\ doorLocked = [l \in Locks |-> FALSE]

Submit(c) ==
    /\ cstate[c] = New
    /\ Len(queue) < QCap
    /\ cstate' = [cstate EXCEPT ![c] = Queued]
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, c)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, doorLocked>>

Deliver ==
    /\ queue # <<>>
    /\ ~crashed[Target(Head(queue))]
    /\ cstate' = [cstate EXCEPT ![Head(queue)] = Delivered]
    /\ doorLocked' = [doorLocked EXCEPT ![Target(Head(queue))] = ~doorLocked[Target(Head(queue))]]
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED crashed

DropHead ==
    /\ queue # <<>>
    /\ crashed[Target(Head(queue))]
    /\ cstate' = [cstate EXCEPT ![Head(queue)] = Dropped]
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, doorLocked>>

Reset(c) ==
    /\ cstate[c] \in {Delivered, Dropped}
    /\ cstate' = [cstate EXCEPT ![c] = New]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, crashed, doorLocked>>

Recover(l) ==
    /\ crashed[l]
    /\ crashed' = [crashed EXCEPT ![l] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cstate, queue, doorLocked>>

Crash(l) ==
    /\ ~crashed[l]
    /\ crashed' = [crashed EXCEPT ![l] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cstate, queue, doorLocked>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cmds : Submit(c) \/ Reset(c)
    \/ Deliver
    \/ DropHead
    \/ \E l \in Locks : Crash(l) \/ Recover(l)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<cstate, queue, crashed, doorLocked>>

NoDup == \A i, j \in 1..Len(queue) : queue[i] = queue[j] => i = j
QueueConserved == /\ Range(queue) = {c \in Cmds : cstate[c] = Queued}
                  /\ NoDup
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    NCmds = 3
    NLocks = 2
    QCap = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TypeOK
INVARIANT QueueConserved
nl:
A smart-home hub dispatches lock and unlock commands to a set of door locks over a bounded command queue. Each command names a target lock and starts life as new, then may be enqueued, then delivered and applied, or dropped, after which it may be reset and reissued. The queue has a hard length cap, and the hub applies backpressure: it refuses to enqueue a new command while the queue is already full. A door lock can crash silently at any time; once crashed it stops accepting commands. When the command at the head of the queue targets a crashed lock, it is timed out and dropped rather than delivered. The queue sequence and the per-command status are two representations of the same pending set and must always agree, so that no queued command is ever lost or silently duplicated.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the set of commands sitting in the queue sequence is exactly the set of commands whose status is queued, with no duplicates, so every in-flight command is conserved in exactly one recorded place.

---- MODULE W4Od14m0p2t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Drones, NSectors, VerMod
ASSUME NSectors \in Nat /\ VerMod \in (Nat \ {0})
VARIABLES freePool, held, version, rver

RECURSIVE SumOf(_, _)
SumOf(f, S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
               ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOf(f, S \ {x})

TypeOK ==
    /\ freePool \in 0..NSectors
    /\ held \in [Drones -> 0..NSectors]
    /\ version \in 0..(VerMod - 1)
    /\ rver \in [Drones -> 0..(VerMod - 1)]

Init ==
    /\ freePool = NSectors
    /\ held = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
    /\ version = 0
    /\ rver = [d \in Drones |-> 0]

ReRead(d) ==
    /\ rver' = [rver EXCEPT ![d] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<freePool, held, version>>

Claim(d) ==
    /\ rver[d] = version
    /\ freePool > 0
    /\ freePool' = freePool - 1
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![d] = held[d] + 1]
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % VerMod
    /\ UNCHANGED rver

Release(d) ==
    /\ held[d] > 0
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![d] = held[d] - 1]
    /\ freePool' = freePool + 1
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % VerMod
    /\ UNCHANGED rver

AdminMove(d1, d2) ==
    /\ d1 # d2
    /\ held[d1] > 0
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![d1] = held[d1] - 1, ![d2] = held[d2] + 1]
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % VerMod
    /\ UNCHANGED <<freePool, rver>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : ReRead(d) \/ Claim(d) \/ Release(d)
    \/ \E d1 \in Drones, d2 \in Drones : AdminMove(d1, d2)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<freePool, held, version, rver>>

CoverageConserved == freePool + SumOf(held, Drones) = NSectors
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Drones = {d1, d2, d3}
    NSectors = 3
    VerMod = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TypeOK
INVARIANT CoverageConserved
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm divides a region into a fixed number of sectors that must be covered. Sectors are either unassigned in a free pool or claimed by exactly one drone. Drones claim work optimistically: a drone reads a shared configuration version, and its claim of a free sector succeeds only if the version it read is still current, after which the version advances; otherwise the drone must re-read and retry. A drone may also release a sector back to the free pool. A privileged ground controller can override the optimistic protocol entirely, forcibly moving one sector's coverage from one drone to another without regard to the version. Through claims, releases, and overrides alike, the total amount of coverage capacity is conserved: the number of free sectors plus the number of sectors held across all drones is always the fixed regional total.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the free-sector count plus the total sectors held by all drones always equals the fixed number of sectors in the region, so coverage capacity is never created or destroyed.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od12m0p0t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Workers, None, VerMod
ASSUME None \notin Workers /\ VerMod \in (Nat \ {0})
VARIABLES version, holder, wstate, rver

Idle == "idle"
Trying == "trying"
InCS == "cs"
Crashed == "crashed"

TypeOK ==
    /\ version \in 0..(VerMod - 1)
    /\ holder = None \/ holder \in Workers
    /\ wstate \in [Workers -> {Idle, Trying, InCS, Crashed}]
    /\ rver \in [Workers -> 0..(VerMod - 1)]

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ holder = None
    /\ wstate = [w \in Workers |-> Idle]
    /\ rver = [w \in Workers |-> 0]

ReadVer(w) ==
    /\ wstate[w] = Idle
    /\ wstate' = [wstate EXCEPT ![w] = Trying]
    /\ rver' = [rver EXCEPT ![w] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, holder>>

Enter(w) ==
    /\ wstate[w] = Trying
    /\ rver[w] = version
    /\ holder = None
    /\ holder' = w
    /\ wstate' = [wstate EXCEPT ![w] = InCS]
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % VerMod
    /\ UNCHANGED rver

Retry(w) ==
    /\ wstate[w] = Trying
    /\ rver[w] # version
    /\ wstate' = [wstate EXCEPT ![w] = Idle]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, holder, rver>>

Exit(w) ==
    /\ wstate[w] = InCS
    /\ holder = w
    /\ holder' = None
    /\ wstate' = [wstate EXCEPT ![w] = Idle]
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % VerMod
    /\ UNCHANGED rver

Crash(w) ==
    /\ wstate[w] \in {Trying, InCS}
    /\ wstate' = [wstate EXCEPT ![w] = Crashed]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, holder, rver>>

Cleanup(w) ==
    /\ wstate[w] = Crashed
    /\ wstate' = [wstate EXCEPT ![w] = Idle]
    /\ holder' = IF holder = w THEN None ELSE holder
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, rver>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers : ReadVer(w) \/ Enter(w) \/ Retry(w) \/ Exit(w) \/ Crash(w) \/ Cleanup(w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<version, holder, wstate, rver>>

MutexHolder == \A w \in Workers : wstate[w] = InCS => holder = w
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Workers = {w1, w2, w3}
    None = none
    VerMod = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TypeOK
INVARIANT MutexHolder
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker lets several worker processes contend for the single dispensing station, which is a critical resource that only one worker may occupy at a time. Access uses optimistic locking: a worker first reads the station's version number, then attempts to enter only if the version it read still matches the current version and the station is free; a successful entry bumps the version. If the version has moved on since the worker read it, the attempt fails and the worker retries by re-reading. A worker can crash silently at any point while trying or while occupying the station; a crashed worker is later cleaned up, and if it held the station the station is released. The holder field and the per-worker occupancy state are kept consistent so that the station is never simultaneously occupied by two different workers.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every worker recorded as occupying the dispensing station is the recorded holder, so at most one worker is ever in the critical station at once.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od13m1p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS N, MaxPending, MaxApplied
ASSUME N \in (Nat \ {0})
VARIABLES token, reg, applied, pending

Machines == 1..N
Nextm(m) == IF m = N THEN 1 ELSE m + 1

RECURSIVE SumOf(_, _)
SumOf(f, S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
               ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOf(f, S \ {x})

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Machines
    /\ reg \in 0..(N * MaxApplied)
    /\ applied \in [Machines -> 0..MaxApplied]
    /\ pending \in [Machines -> 0..MaxPending]

Init ==
    /\ token = 1
    /\ reg = 0
    /\ applied = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
    /\ pending = [m \in Machines |-> 0]

Sell(m) ==
    /\ pending[m] < MaxPending
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![m] = pending[m] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, reg, applied>>

Push(m) ==
    /\ token = m
    /\ pending[m] > 0
    /\ applied[m] < MaxApplied
    /\ reg' = reg + 1
    /\ applied' = [applied EXCEPT ![m] = applied[m] + 1]
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![m] = pending[m] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED token

Refund(m) ==
    /\ token = m
    /\ reg > 0
    /\ applied[m] > 0
    /\ reg' = reg - 1
    /\ applied' = [applied EXCEPT ![m] = applied[m] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, pending>>

Pass(m) ==
    /\ token = m
    /\ token' = Nextm(m)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, applied, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Sell(m) \/ Push(m) \/ Refund(m) \/ Pass(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<token, reg, applied, pending>>

NoLostUpdate == reg = SumOf(applied, Machines)
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    N = 3
    MaxPending = 2
    MaxApplied = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TypeOK
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A network of vending machines shares a single sales register. Exclusive write access circulates as a token around a fixed ring of machines: at any moment exactly one machine holds the token. A machine records local sales into a private pending counter whenever a customer buys, and it may also owe refunds. Only the machine currently holding the token may push its pending sales into the shared register or apply a refund against it, one unit at a time, so writes are fully serialized and no two machines ever race on the register. A machine may be slow -- it can hold the token for a while without pushing anything -- but it has not failed, and it eventually passes the token onward. The register must always equal the exact total of every increment that machines have applied, so that no committed sale is ever silently lost.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the shared register always equals the sum of all per-machine applied increments, so serialized writes through the token never drop a committed update.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m0p5t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences
CONSTANTS Drones, Fires, VerMod, MaxCap
ASSUME VerMod \in (Nat \ {0}) /\ MaxCap \in Nat
VARIABLES fireState, version, rver, dlog, cap

Burning == "burning"
Doused == "doused"
Range(q) == {q[i] : i \in 1..Len(q)}

TypeOK ==
    /\ fireState \in [Fires -> {Burning, Doused}]
    /\ version \in 0..(VerMod - 1)
    /\ rver \in [Drones -> 0..(VerMod - 1)]
    /\ dlog \in Seq(Fires)
    /\ cap \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ fireState = [f \in Fires |-> Burning]
    /\ version = 0
    /\ rver = [d \in Drones |-> 0]
    /\ dlog = <<>>
    /\ cap = MaxCap

ReRead(d) ==
    /\ rver' = [rver EXCEPT ![d] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fireState, version, dlog, cap>>

Douse(d, f) ==
    /\ fireState[f] = Burning
    /\ rver[d] = version
    /\ cap > 0
    /\ fireState' = [fireState EXCEPT ![f] = Doused]
    /\ dlog' = Append(dlog, f)
    /\ cap' = cap - 1
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % VerMod
    /\ UNCHANGED rver

LoadTanker ==
    /\ cap < MaxCap
    /\ cap' = cap + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fireState, version, rver, dlog>>

UnloadTanker ==
    /\ cap > 0
    /\ cap' = cap - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fireState, version, rver, dlog>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : ReRead(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones, f \in Fires : Douse(d, f)
    \/ LoadTanker
    \/ UnloadTanker

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<fireState, version, rver, dlog, cap>>

DouseOnce ==
    /\ \A i, j \in 1..Len(dlog) : dlog[i] = dlog[j] => i = j
    /\ \A f \in Fires : (fireState[f] = Doused) <=> (f \in Range(dlog))
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Drones = {d1, d2}
    Fires = {f1, f2}
    VerMod = 3
    MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TypeOK
INVARIANT DouseOnce
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm drops fire retardant on a set of fires. Each fire is either burning or has been doused, and dousing a fire is irreversible. Drones coordinate optimistically against a shared coverage version: a drone re-reads the current version, and its douse of a burning fire succeeds only if the version it holds is still current, after which the version advances. Each douse consumes one unit of retardant capacity, and that capacity changes at runtime as tankers are loaded and unloaded. Every successful douse is appended to an operations log. Because a fire can only be doused while it is still burning, and dousing flips it out of the burning state, no fire is ever doused more than once, so the operations log never records the same fire twice.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no fire identifier appears more than once in the douse operations log, so the irreversible dousing of any given fire happens at most once.

---- MODULE W4Od17m0p3t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS NBags, NSlots, VerMod
ASSUME NBags \in (Nat \ {0}) /\ NSlots \in (Nat \ {0}) /\ VerMod \in (Nat \ {0})
VARIABLES slotOwner, bagSlot, slotVer, rslot, rver, bstate

Bags == 1..NBags
Slots == 1..NSlots
Active == "active"
Crashed == "crashed"

TypeOK ==
    /\ slotOwner \in [Slots -> 0..NBags]
    /\ bagSlot \in [Bags -> 0..NSlots]
    /\ slotVer \in [Slots -> 0..(VerMod - 1)]
    /\ rslot \in [Bags -> 0..NSlots]
    /\ rver \in [Bags -> 0..(VerMod - 1)]
    /\ bstate \in [Bags -> {Active, Crashed}]

Init ==
    /\ slotOwner = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ bagSlot = [b \in Bags |-> 0]
    /\ slotVer = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ rslot = [b \in Bags |-> 0]
    /\ rver = [b \in Bags |-> 0]
    /\ bstate = [b \in Bags |-> Active]

ReadSlot(b, s) ==
    /\ bstate[b] = Active
    /\ rslot' = [rslot EXCEPT ![b] = s]
    /\ rver' = [rver EXCEPT ![b] = slotVer[s]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOwner, bagSlot, slotVer, bstate>>

Claim(b) ==
    /\ bstate[b] = Active
    /\ rslot[b] # 0
    /\ bagSlot[b] = 0
    /\ slotOwner[rslot[b]] = 0
    /\ rver[b] = slotVer[rslot[b]]
    /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![rslot[b]] = b]
    /\ bagSlot' = [bagSlot EXCEPT ![b] = rslot[b]]
    /\ slotVer' = [slotVer EXCEPT ![rslot[b]] = (slotVer[rslot[b]] + 1) % VerMod]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rslot, rver, bstate>>

Release(b) ==
    /\ bagSlot[b] # 0
    /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![bagSlot[b]] = 0]
    /\ slotVer' = [slotVer EXCEPT ![bagSlot[b]] = (slotVer[bagSlot[b]] + 1) % VerMod]
    /\ bagSlot' = [bagSlot EXCEPT ![b] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rslot, rver, bstate>>

Crash(b) ==
    /\ bstate[b] = Active
    /\ bstate' = [bstate EXCEPT ![b] = Crashed]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotOwner, bagSlot, slotVer, rslot, rver>>

Recover(b) ==
    /\ bstate[b] = Crashed
    /\ slotOwner' = [s \in Slots |-> IF bagSlot[b] # 0 /\ s = bagSlot[b] THEN 0 ELSE slotOwner[s]]
    /\ bagSlot' = [bagSlot EXCEPT ![b] = 0]
    /\ bstate' = [bstate EXCEPT ![b] = Active]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotVer, rslot, rver>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Bags, s \in Slots : ReadSlot(b, s)
    \/ \E b \in Bags : Claim(b) \/ Release(b) \/ Crash(b) \/ Recover(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<slotOwner, bagSlot, slotVer, rslot, rver, bstate>>

NoDoubleAlloc ==
    /\ \A b \in Bags : bagSlot[b] # 0 => slotOwner[bagSlot[b]] = b
    /\ \A s \in Slots : slotOwner[s] # 0 => bagSlot[slotOwner[s]] = s
====
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    NBags = 2
    NSlots = 2
    VerMod = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TypeOK
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
An airport baggage router assigns bags to loading slots. Each slot may hold at most one bag, and each bag holds at most one slot; the slot-owner map and the bag-slot map are two directions of the same assignment and must always agree. Bags claim slots optimistically: a bag reads a slot together with that slot's version, then commits the claim only if the slot is still free and its version is unchanged, after which the slot's version advances. A bag may release its slot, freeing it. A bag handler can crash silently while active, leaving its slot held; a later recovery step reclaims the slot of a crashed bag and frees it. The two-way consistency of the maps guarantees that a single slot is never allocated to two different bags at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a bag holds a slot the slot's owner is that bag, and whenever a slot has an owner that owner holds the slot, so no slot is ever double-allocated to two bags.

---- MODULE W4Od15m5p4t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
CONSTANTS Orders, Nodes, Cap, Quorum
ASSUME Cap \in Nat /\ Quorum \in (Nat \ {0})
VARIABLES status, voted, current, bookCount

Waiting == "waiting"
Proposed == "proposed"
Admitted == "admitted"
Rejected == "rejected"
NoOrder == "none"

Yes(v) == {n \in Nodes : v[n]}

TypeOK ==
    /\ status \in [Orders -> {Waiting, Proposed, Admitted, Rejected}]
    /\ voted \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ current = NoOrder \/ current \in Orders
    /\ bookCount \in 0..Cap

Init ==
    /\ status = [o \in Orders |-> Waiting]
    /\ voted = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
    /\ current = NoOrder
    /\ bookCount = 0

Propose(o) ==
    /\ current = NoOrder
    /\ status[o] = Waiting
    /\ bookCount < Cap
    /\ current' = o
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![o] = Proposed]
    /\ voted' = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED bookCount

CastVote(n) ==
    /\ current # NoOrder
    /\ ~voted[n]
    /\ voted' = [voted EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, current, bookCount>>

Admit ==
    /\ current # NoOrder
    /\ Cardinality(Yes(voted)) >= Quorum
    /\ bookCount < Cap
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![current] = Admitted]
    /\ bookCount' = bookCount + 1
    /\ current' = NoOrder
    /\ UNCHANGED voted

Reject ==
    /\ current # NoOrder
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![current] = Rejected]
    /\ current' = NoOrder
    /\ UNCHANGED <<voted, bookCount>>

Fill(o) ==
    /\ status[o] = Admitted
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![o] = Waiting]
    /\ bookCount' = bookCount - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<voted, current>>

Reopen(o) ==
    /\ status[o] = Rejected
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![o] = Waiting]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<voted, current, bookCount>>

Next ==
    \/ \E o \in Orders : Propose(o) \/ Fill(o) \/ Reopen(o)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : CastVote(n)
    \/ Admit
    \/ Reject

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<status, voted, current, bookCount>>

CapacityOK ==
    /\ bookCount = Cardinality({o \in Orders : status[o] = Admitted})
    /\ bookCount <= Cap
====

CONSTANTS
    Orders = {o1, o2, o3}
    Nodes = {n1, n2, n3}
    Cap = 2
    Quorum = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TypeOK
INVARIANT CapacityOK
nl:
A stock exchange opening auction admits orders into a book that can hold at most a fixed number of orders. Each admission decision is made by quorum voting among a set of matching-engine nodes. At any time at most one order is under consideration: it is proposed, then nodes cast yes-votes for it, and once a quorum of nodes has voted the order is admitted into the book, provided the book is not already full. A node may be slow and never get around to voting on a given proposal, but it has not failed, and a quorum can still form from the other nodes. A proposal that will not be pursued can instead be rejected. Admitted orders eventually fill and leave the book, and rejected orders can be reopened, in both cases returning to the waiting pool. The recorded book count always matches the number of orders marked admitted, and it never exceeds the book's fixed capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the book count equals the number of orders marked admitted and never exceeds the fixed capacity, so the auction book's bounded capacity is never exceeded.

A car-wash conveyor line applies a final wax seal to each car exactly once. A car moves from dirty to washed to sealed, and sealing is irreversible. The sealing station is coordinated optimistically: a car's controller re-reads a shared station version, and its seal of a washed car commits only if the version it holds is still current, after which the version advances. Each seal is stamped with a unique, ever-increasing serial number drawn from a dispenser, and a car is sealed exactly when it carries a nonzero serial. A controller may be slow to act -- it can leave a washed car waiting -- but it has not failed. Because a car is sealed only while washed and sealing carries it out of the washed state, every seal serial is distinct and each car is sealed at most once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: a car carries a nonzero seal serial exactly when it is sealed, and no two cars ever carry the same seal serial, so each car's irreversible sealing happens at most once.

---- MODULE W4Od7m2p3t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS NJobs, NSlots, RMs
VARIABLES slotJob, jobSlot, phase, vote, txn

Idle == "idle"
Active == "active"
NoVote == 0
VYes == 1
VNo == 2

Jobs == 1..NJobs
Slots == 1..NSlots

TypeOK ==
    /\ slotJob \in [Slots -> 0..NJobs]
    /\ jobSlot \in [Jobs -> 0..NSlots]
    /\ phase \in {Idle, Active}
    /\ vote \in [RMs -> {NoVote, VYes, VNo}]
    /\ txn \in [job : 0..NJobs, slot : 0..NSlots]

Init ==
    /\ slotJob = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ jobSlot = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
    /\ phase = Idle
    /\ vote = [r \in RMs |-> NoVote]
    /\ txn = [job |-> 0, slot |-> 0]

Begin(j, s) ==
    /\ phase = Idle
    /\ slotJob[s] = 0
    /\ jobSlot[j] = 0
    /\ phase' = Active
    /\ txn' = [job |-> j, slot |-> s]
    /\ vote' = [r \in RMs |-> NoVote]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotJob, jobSlot>>

CastVote(r, v) ==
    /\ phase = Active
    /\ vote[r] = NoVote
    /\ v \in {VYes, VNo}
    /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![r] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotJob, jobSlot, phase, txn>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = Active
    /\ \A r \in RMs : vote[r] = VYes
    /\ slotJob[txn.slot] = 0
    /\ jobSlot[txn.job] = 0
    /\ slotJob' = [slotJob EXCEPT ![txn.slot] = txn.job]
    /\ jobSlot' = [jobSlot EXCEPT ![txn.job] = txn.slot]
    /\ phase' = Idle
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, txn>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = Active
    /\ \E r \in RMs : vote[r] = VNo
    /\ phase' = Idle
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotJob, jobSlot, vote, txn>>

Free(j) ==
    /\ jobSlot[j] # 0
    /\ slotJob' = [slotJob EXCEPT ![jobSlot[j]] = 0]
    /\ jobSlot' = [jobSlot EXCEPT ![j] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, vote, txn>>

Next ==
    \/ \E j \in Jobs, s \in Slots : Begin(j, s)
    \/ \E r \in RMs, v \in {VYes, VNo} : CastVote(r, v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Free(j)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<slotJob, jobSlot, phase, vote, txn>>

NoDoubleAlloc ==
    /\ \A j \in Jobs : jobSlot[j] # 0 => slotJob[jobSlot[j]] = j
    /\ \A s \in Slots : slotJob[s] # 0 => jobSlot[slotJob[s]] = s
====

CONSTANTS
    NJobs = 2
    NSlots = 2
    RMs = {m1, m2}
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TypeOK
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A container-ship crane yard allocates ground slots to jobs using two-phase commit across a set of resource managers. A coordinator opens a transaction proposing to place a job in a slot, and each resource manager independently votes yes or no; because managers vote independently, their votes may be recorded in any order. The transaction commits only if every manager voted yes and the target slot is still free, at which point the slot is assigned to the job and, symmetrically, the job records the slot it holds. Either map -- slot-to-job or job-to-slot -- is a view of the same assignment and they must agree. A committed allocation can later be freed. The two-way agreement of the maps guarantees that a single slot is never assigned to two different jobs at the same time.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a job holds a slot that slot's owner is that job, and whenever a slot has an owner that owner holds the slot, so no slot is ever allocated to two jobs at once.

ASSUME NRxs \in (Nat \ {0}) /\ NDrawers \in (Nat \ {0})
VARIABLES cabinetLock, drawerLock, rxState, alog

Rxs == 1..NRxs
Drawers == 1..NDrawers
DrawerOf(r) == ((r - 1) % NDrawers) + 1

Pending == "pending"
Dispensed == "dispensed"
Range(q) == {q[i] : i \in 1..Len(q)}

TypeOK ==
    /\ cabinetLock \in 0..Pharmacists
    /\ drawerLock \in [Drawers -> 0..Pharmacists]
    /\ rxState \in [Rxs -> {Pending, Dispensed}]
    /\ alog \in Seq(Rxs)

Init ==
    /\ cabinetLock = 0
    /\ drawerLock = [d \in Drawers |-> 0]
    /\ rxState = [r \in Rxs |-> Pending]
    /\ alog = <<>>

TakeCabinet(p) ==
    /\ cabinetLock = 0
    /\ cabinetLock' = p
    /\ UNCHANGED <<drawerLock, rxState, alog>>

TakeDrawer(p, d) ==
    /\ cabinetLock = p
    /\ drawerLock[d] = 0
    /\ drawerLock' = [drawerLock EXCEPT ![d] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cabinetLock, rxState, alog>>

Dispense(p, r) ==
    /\ cabinetLock = p
    /\ drawerLock[DrawerOf(r)] = p
    /\ rxState[r] = Pending
    /\ rxState' = [rxState EXCEPT ![r] = Dispensed]
    /\ alog' = Append(alog, r)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cabinetLock, drawerLock>>

ReleaseAll(p) ==
    /\ cabinetLock = p
    /\ cabinetLock' = 0
    /\ drawerLock' = [d \in Drawers |-> IF drawerLock[d] = p THEN 0 ELSE drawerLock[d]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rxState, alog>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in 1..Pharmacists : TakeCabinet(p) \/ ReleaseAll(p)
    \/ \E p \in 1..Pharmacists, d \in Drawers : TakeDrawer(p, d)
    \/ \E p \in 1..Pharmacists, r \in Rxs : Dispense(p, r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<cabinetLock, drawerLock, rxState, alog>>

DispenseOnce ==
    /\ \A i, j \in 1..Len(alog) : alog[i] = alog[j] => i = j
    /\ \A r \in Rxs : (rxState[r] = Dispensed) <=> (r \in Range(alog))

    NRxs = 2
    NDrawers = 2

NEXT Next

INVARIANT DispenseOnce
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser fills prescriptions, and each prescription must be dispensed at most once. To dispense, a pharmacist must acquire two locks in a strict hierarchy: first the coarse cabinet lock, then the fine lock on the specific drawer holding the drug. Only while holding both locks may the pharmacist dispense a pending prescription, which flips it to dispensed and appends it to an audit log. A pharmacist may be slow, holding locks without acting, but has not failed and eventually releases them. Because a prescription is dispensed only while pending and dispensing moves it out of the pending state, the audit log never records the same prescription twice, and the set of dispensed prescriptions is exactly the set recorded in the log.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no prescription identifier appears more than once in the dispensing audit log, so each prescription is irreversibly dispensed at most once.

---- MODULE W4Od10m8p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Trains, Blocks, Region
VARIABLES regionLock, fineLock, occ, pending

TypeOK ==
    /\ regionLock \in 0..Trains
    /\ fineLock \in [Blocks -> 0..Trains]
    /\ occ \in [Blocks -> 0..Trains]
    /\ pending \in SUBSET ((1..Trains) \X Blocks)

Init ==
    /\ regionLock = 0
    /\ fineLock = [b \in Blocks |-> 0]
    /\ occ = [b \in Blocks |-> 0]
    /\ pending = {}

Request(t, b) ==
    /\ <<t, b>> \notin pending
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {<<t, b>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, fineLock, occ>>

GrantRegion(t, b) ==
    /\ <<t, b>> \in pending
    /\ regionLock = 0
    /\ regionLock' = t
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineLock, occ, pending>>

GrantFine(t, b) ==
    /\ <<t, b>> \in pending
    /\ regionLock = t
    /\ fineLock[b] = 0
    /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![b] = t]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, occ, pending>>

Enter(t, b) ==
    /\ regionLock = t
    /\ fineLock[b] = t
    /\ occ[b] = 0
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![b] = t]
    /\ pending' = pending \ {<<t, b>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, fineLock>>

Leave(t, b) ==
    /\ occ[b] = t
    /\ occ' = [occ EXCEPT ![b] = 0]
    /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![b] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<regionLock, pending>>

ReleaseRegion(t) ==
    /\ regionLock = t
    /\ \A b \in Blocks : occ[b] # t
    /\ \A b \in Blocks : fineLock[b] # t
    /\ regionLock' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineLock, occ, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in 1..Trains, b \in Blocks :
         Request(t, b) \/ GrantRegion(t, b) \/ GrantFine(t, b) \/ Enter(t, b) \/ Leave(t, b)
    \/ \E t \in 1..Trains : ReleaseRegion(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_<<regionLock, fineLock, occ, pending>>

Authorized ==
    \A b \in Blocks : occ[b] # 0 => (regionLock = occ[b] /\ fineLock[b] = occ[b])
====

    Blocks = {b1, b2}

nl:
A subway signalling block system controls train movement over a line divided into track blocks that all sit within one interlocking region. To occupy a block a train must hold two locks in a strict hierarchy: first the coarse region interlocking lock, then the fine per-block lock. Movement authority requests are posted into an unordered pool and serviced by the interlocking in any order, so grant messages may effectively be processed out of the order they were requested. A train may only enter a block if it currently holds both the region lock and that block's lock; a train that never obtained the proper locks is not authorized to occupy the block. When a train leaves a block it releases that block's fine lock, and once it holds no blocks and no fine locks it releases the region lock so another train can be authorized.
SAFETY PROPERTY: every train occupying a block holds both the region interlocking lock and that block's fine lock, so no unauthorized or stale train ever occupies a block.

    /\ shelf \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ reserved \in 0..MaxCap

Elect(n) ==

    /\ leader' = 0
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, shelf, reserved, capacity>>

Restock ==

    /\ shelf' = shelf + 1
    /\ capacity' = capacity + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, reserved>>

Dispose ==

    /\ shelf' = shelf - 1
    /\ capacity' = capacity - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, reserved>>

Reserve(n) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ shelf > 0
    /\ shelf' = shelf - 1
    /\ reserved' = reserved + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, capacity>>

ReturnPill(n) ==
    /\ leader = n
    /\ reserved > 0
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ shelf' = shelf + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, capacity>>

    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ capacity' = capacity - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, shelf>>

    \/ Failover \/ Restock \/ Dispose

nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser is replicated across several nodes, exactly one of which acts as leader. Leadership is elected: when there is no leader a node may win an election and become leader, advancing the term; a leader can fail over, leaving the post vacant for a new election. Only the current leader may operate the inventory. SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of pills on the shelf plus the number reserved by the leader always equals the current capacity, so pills are neither created nor destroyed except by explicit restock and disposal.

    /\ deadline = [d \in Drones |-> 0]

    /\ capacity = 0

AddCredit ==
    /\ capacity < MaxCap
    /\ capacity' = capacity + 1
    /\ freePool' = freePool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leased, deadline, clock>>

RemoveCredit ==

    /\ capacity' = capacity - 1
    /\ freePool' = freePool - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leased, deadline, clock>>

    /\ freePool' = freePool - 1
    /\ leased' = [leased EXCEPT ![d] = leased[d] + 1]
    /\ deadline' = [deadline EXCEPT ![d] = IF clock + Lease <= MaxClock THEN clock + Lease ELSE MaxClock]

    /\ leased' = [leased EXCEPT ![d] = leased[d] - 1]

    /\ UNCHANGED <<deadline, clock, capacity>>

    /\ leased' = [leased EXCEPT ![d] = leased[d] - 1]
    /\ freePool' = freePool + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<deadline, clock, capacity>>

    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<freePool, leased, deadline, capacity>>

    \/ \E d \in Drones : TakeLease(d) \/ ReturnLease(d) \/ ExpireLease(d)

nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm shares a pool of battery-swap credits. Each credit is either free in the depot pool or leased to a drone, and a lease carries an expiry deadline measured against a shared clock. A drone leases a free credit, stamping an expiry, and may return it early. If a lease's deadline passes, the depot reclaims the credit even without the drone's cooperation. SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of free credits in the depot pool plus the total leased across all drones always equals the current capacity, so credits are conserved except by explicit add and remove.

CONSTANTS Trains, Blocks, MaxIssue

RECURSIVE SumOf(_, _)
SumOf(f, S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
               ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOf(f, S \ {x})

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarseLock \in 0..Trains
    /\ fineLock \in [Blocks -> 0..Trains]
    /\ authLog \in Seq(Blocks)
    /\ issued \in [Blocks -> 0..MaxIssue]

Init ==
    /\ coarseLock = 0
    /\ fineLock = [b \in Blocks |-> 0]
    /\ authLog = <<>>
    /\ issued = [b \in Blocks |-> 0]

TakeCoarse(t) ==
    /\ coarseLock = 0
    /\ coarseLock' = t
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineLock, authLog, issued>>

TakeFine(t, b) ==
    /\ coarseLock = t
    /\ fineLock[b] = 0
    /\ fineLock' = [fineLock EXCEPT ![b] = t]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, authLog, issued>>

Issue(t, b) ==
    /\ coarseLock = t
    /\ fineLock[b] = t
    /\ issued[b] < MaxIssue
    /\ authLog' = Append(authLog, b)
    /\ issued' = [issued EXCEPT ![b] = issued[b] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, fineLock>>

ReleaseAll(t) ==
    /\ coarseLock = t
    /\ coarseLock' = 0
    /\ fineLock' = [b \in Blocks |-> IF fineLock[b] = t THEN 0 ELSE fineLock[b]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<authLog, issued>>

AdminIssue(b) ==
    /\ issued[b] < MaxIssue
    /\ authLog' = Append(authLog, b)
    /\ issued' = [issued EXCEPT ![b] = issued[b] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, fineLock>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in 1..Trains : TakeCoarse(t) \/ ReleaseAll(t)
    \/ \E t \in 1..Trains, b \in Blocks : TakeFine(t, b) \/ Issue(t, b)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : AdminIssue(b)

---- MODULE W4Od14m2p1t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Drones, RMs, MaxApplied
ASSUME MaxApplied \in Nat
VARIABLES tally, applied, phase, vote, current

Idle == "idle"
Active == "active"
NoVote == 0
VYes == 1
VNo == 2

RECURSIVE SumOf(_, _)
SumOf(f, S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
               ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumOf(f, S \ {x})

    /\ tally \in 0..(Drones * MaxApplied)
    /\ applied \in [1..Drones -> 0..MaxApplied]
    /\ phase \in {Idle, Active}
    /\ vote \in [RMs -> {NoVote, VYes, VNo}]
    /\ current \in 0..Drones

Init ==
    /\ tally = 0
    /\ applied = [d \in 1..Drones |-> 0]
    /\ phase = Idle
    /\ vote = [r \in RMs |-> NoVote]
    /\ current = 0

Begin(d) ==
    /\ phase = Idle
    /\ applied[d] < MaxApplied
    /\ phase' = Active
    /\ current' = d
    /\ vote' = [r \in RMs |-> NoVote]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tally, applied>>

CastVote(r, v) ==
    /\ phase = Active
    /\ vote[r] = NoVote
    /\ v \in {VYes, VNo}
    /\ vote' = [vote EXCEPT ![r] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tally, applied, phase, current>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = Active
    /\ \A r \in RMs : vote[r] = VYes
    /\ applied[current] < MaxApplied
    /\ tally' = tally + 1
    /\ applied' = [applied EXCEPT ![current] = applied[current] + 1]
    /\ phase' = Idle
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vote, current>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = Active
    /\ \E r \in RMs : vote[r] = VNo
    /\ phase' = Idle
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tally, applied, vote, current>>

AdminForce(d) ==
    /\ applied[d] < MaxApplied
    /\ tally' = tally + 1
    /\ applied' = [applied EXCEPT ![d] = applied[d] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, vote, current>>

Archive(d) ==
    /\ applied[d] > 0
    /\ tally' = tally - 1
    /\ applied' = [applied EXCEPT ![d] = applied[d] - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, vote, current>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in 1..Drones : Begin(d) \/ AdminForce(d) \/ Archive(d)
    \/ \E r \in RMs, v \in {VYes, VNo} : CastVote(r, v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort

EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANTS Handlers, GenMod
ASSUME GenMod \in (Nat \ {0})
VARIABLES lockReg, gen, hstate, rreg, rgen

Idle == "idle"
Trying == "trying"
InCS == "cs"

    /\ lockReg \in 0..Handlers
    /\ gen \in 0..(GenMod - 1)
    /\ hstate \in [1..Handlers -> {Idle, Trying, InCS}]
    /\ rreg \in [1..Handlers -> 0..Handlers]
    /\ rgen \in [1..Handlers -> 0..(GenMod - 1)]

Init ==
    /\ lockReg = 0
    /\ gen = 0
    /\ hstate = [h \in 1..Handlers |-> Idle]
    /\ rreg = [h \in 1..Handlers |-> 0]
    /\ rgen = [h \in 1..Handlers |-> 0]

ReadReg(h) ==
    /\ hstate[h] = Idle
    /\ hstate' = [hstate EXCEPT ![h] = Trying]
    /\ rreg' = [rreg EXCEPT ![h] = lockReg]
    /\ rgen' = [rgen EXCEPT ![h] = gen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lockReg, gen>>

AcquireCAS(h) ==
    /\ hstate[h] = Trying
    /\ rreg[h] = 0
    /\ rgen[h] = gen
    /\ lockReg = 0
    /\ lockReg' = h
    /\ hstate' = [hstate EXCEPT ![h] = InCS]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, rreg, rgen>>

RetryAcq(h) ==
    /\ hstate[h] = Trying
    /\ (lockReg # 0 \/ rgen[h] # gen)
    /\ hstate' = [hstate EXCEPT ![h] = Idle]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lockReg, gen, rreg, rgen>>

ReleaseReg(h) ==
    /\ hstate[h] = InCS
    /\ lockReg = h
    /\ lockReg' = 0
    /\ gen' = (gen + 1) % GenMod
    /\ hstate' = [hstate EXCEPT ![h] = Idle]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rreg, rgen>>

Next ==
    \/ \E h \in 1..Handlers : ReadReg(h) \/ AcquireCAS(h) \/ RetryAcq(h) \/ ReleaseReg(h)

    /\ \A h \in 1..Handlers : hstate[h] = InCS => lockReg = h

nl:
An airport baggage router protects a single re-scan chute, a critical resource that only one handler process may use at a time. Access is arbitrated by a compare-and-swap lock register that holds either zero, meaning free, or the identifier of the handler that owns it, together with a generation number that advances every time the chute is released. A handler that wants the chute reads both the register and the generation, then performs a compare-and-swap that succeeds only if the register still holds the free value and the generation is unchanged since the read, setting the register to itself and entering the critical section. If either moved on, the attempt fails and the handler re-reads to retry. A handler may be slow, occupying the chute for a while, but it has not failed and eventually releases the register, advancing the generation. The lock register and the handlers' critical-section states are kept consistent so the chute is never used by two handlers at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever a handler is in the critical section the lock register names that handler, so at most one handler ever uses the re-scan chute at a time.
